selection_basis: Repeatable public index or bounded current programme, drawn from the two earlier acquisition studies and target-blind public listing checks before Day 0 candidate capture. A post-freeze diagnostic prompted evaluation but did not by itself qualify any source.

sources.enumeration_method: Traverse On Today and Upcoming pagination for the current date and next 11 days; inspect every in-scope linked card until terminal page or cap.
sources.freshness_visibility: Current-date heading and per-card active/started/ends labels; detail validity must be checked.
sources.pagination: Numbered /page/N/; 9 On Today pages observed on 23 Sep.
sources.ordering: Appears editorial/recent but not a reliable publication-time sort; do not stop after first ten.
sources.inspectability: Listing and linked offer articles readable in current browser check.
sources.notes: Earlier first-ten cap could hide lower-page offers; cached RSS lagged the active index. Exclude finance, travel and online-only entries.
sources.catch_up_limitation: Current listing enumeration does not prove downtime history traversal.

sources.enumeration_method: Traverse date-labelled Deals cards via Load More until previous observed date plus one overlap batch; inspect in-scope cards.
sources.freshness_visibility: Visible article dates; category also includes menus, events and stale campaigns.
sources.pagination: Follow exposed Older Posts/rel=next URLs. A Load More control without a fetchable URL remains unresolved and blocks completeness; no unrelated category routes are registered.
sources.ordering: Reverse visible publication date on first batch; verify at each load.
sources.inspectability: Article links readable; feed route was inaccessible in prior study.
sources.notes: First-ten cap could miss older still-active offers; Day 0 should keep going until cap and record truncation.
sources.catch_up_limitation: Complete-capable only: durable checkpoint, crossed boundary, verified overlap/order/pagination, no cap or listing failure. Every recovery must prove completeness; capability alone is not proof.

sources.enumeration_method: Traverse dated Deals category and Older Posts to prior observed cutoff plus overlap; split multi-merchant guides into independently redeemable offers.

sources.pagination: Older Posts link and numbered archive pages.
sources.ordering: Reverse visible publication date on first page.
sources.inspectability: Article text readable in earlier and current checks.
sources.notes: Category is sparse; first-ten cap can miss active evergreen offers; new menu prices alone are out of scope.
sources.catch_up_limitation: Complete-capable only: durable checkpoint, crossed boundary, verified overlap/order/pagination, no cap or listing failure. Every recovery must prove completeness; capability alone is not proof.

sources.catch_up_limitation: Current listing enumeration does not prove downtime history traversal.
